report:
Reviewed the complete narrow_detail claim, the sole ordinary implementation association in local_syms/structs.rs, and the complete sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::checking_signature_narrow_detail. Baseline verification: current structs.rs and semantic_spec.rs exactly match historical whole-file snapshots by byte-equivalent text comparison. The historical rationale is consistent with freshly inspected inputs, not substituted for this assessment.

Fresh evidence: LocalStructSym::fields and sig are distinct tracked functions, establishing an independently keyed field-detail query versus owner signature. fields obtains existing generic symbols through self.sig(db).iter_symbols(), then checks field types and returns StructFields; sig constructs the owner binder without enumerating fields. The field query processes its field list collectively, so this is evidence of separation at the field-list boundary, not evidence of arbitrary individual-field isolation. The complete claim also requires independently keyed associated-item enumeration, selection reading only the selected item's signature, and enumeration avoiding eager sibling signatures and bodies. The supplied struct implementation does not establish those associated-item guarantees. They remain covered by the explicit TODO's planned selection/query-trace verification, not approved as complete behavior.

The only associated test has an empty body and no behavioral assertions. Its explicit TODO asks for traces rejecting unselected sibling signatures and all bodies, plus detail-edit tests preserving owner-binder identity and unrelated detail queries. Accepting this deferral is justified: completing the verification requires fixtures and observable query traces for field/associated-item selection and enumeration, and incremental edits with identity/invalidation checks. Those scenarios would detect eager sibling/body reads or an owner/detail dependency collapse; the current placeholder would not. No ordinary behavioral test or N/A entry is present. All guarantees are accounted for as a visible structural example or the documented deferred matrix; no claim of full implementation or test adequacy is made.

Execution: ran review start and exact baseline comparisons and inspected captured source; no behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported build and suite results remain separate execution evidence. No additional implementation helpers were relied on. No source changes requested for the existing explicit deferral.
